name: content-freshness
description: Check for stale content and ecosystem version changes (npm packages, GitHub releases)
scheduleReadable: Every day at 10:00 AM (after content-gap-alerts at 9 AM)

preExec.description: Run freshness checks and send triggered alerts to Discord

instructions: Review the JSON output from the freshness checker.
Stale content alerts list articles older than 90 days — review and update or mark as still current.
npm version change alerts mean the MCP SDK has updated — check changelog for breaking changes.
GitHub release alerts mean a tracked tool (Ollama, Open WebUI, etc.) has a new release.
Ecosystem version info shows current tracked versions for reference.
